persona: Instrumentalist new to DAWs; short melodic piece
evaluation_type: Independent simulated beginner, not a human study

constraints.audio_monitoring: Null output; no claim to hear the composition
constraints.vst: Lab-provided native VST3 polyphonic sine fixture, not third-party compatibility validation
constraints.graphics: Software OpenGL in isolated X11 session

completion.composition: Eight-note staccato melodic figure repeated across 14 bars over stock Circuit rhythm audio, at 112 BPM

ratings_scale: 1 to 5; higher means more of the named category. Higher confusion is worse.

rating_reasons.easy_to_use: Empty-area instruction led directly to MIDI creation; assign, pencil, duplicate, fit, save, and export were discoverable. Exact trimming required a correction.
rating_reasons.how_cool_it_looks: Cohesive dark arrangement, attractive teal waveforms, readable controls and clear selection. Narrow repeated clip titles become New pat... and most piano pitches are unlabeled.
rating_reasons.how_fast_it_is: Routine edits and duplication responded promptly; reached first export in under four minutes. Native file dialogs briefly appeared blank before drawing; lab rendering may contribute, so this is perceived speed, not a benchmark.
rating_reasons.how_confusing_it_is: Low overall friction once the clip editor opened. Duration is in beats, timeline in bars and seconds, and export tail can extend advertised arrangement duration.
rating_reasons.feature_completeness: Audio, native VST MIDI, pencil editing, duplication, trimming, project save, WAV and MIDI export supported the goal. Export dialog exposed only effect tails; sample rate/bit-depth choices were not discoverable. No conclusions about recording, effects, or third-party plugins.

findings.observation: Piano-roll keys label only C octaves. In-between note pitches require counting semitone rows.
findings.suggestion: Show pitch names while hovering and drawing, and offer note labels on keys or notes at suitable zoom.

findings.observation: First mouse trim landed at 8.75 beats instead of 8 on the last audio clip. Properties showed beats only; dragging the numeric duration text selected text rather than adjusting it.
findings.suggestion: Add mouse-operable increment controls and an elapsed-time readout for clip start/end/duration; display a live trim endpoint hint.

findings.observation: Export says Arrangement 0:30.000 with Include effect tails enabled by default, but the exported file measured 30.2 seconds. Unchecking tails gave exact 30.0 seconds.
findings.suggestion: Clarify that tails extend the file duration and label the displayed time as arrangement duration, with an estimate or actual final duration when available.

findings.observation: After MIDI export the persistent status still read Exported Midnight circuit.wav, leaving no visible confirmation of the MIDI action. The MIDI file did exist.
findings.suggestion: Give consistent success/error status for every save/export operation, including the correct file type and name.

findings.observation: WAV export presents no visible sample-rate or bit-depth options.
findings.suggestion: Provide a compact advanced section or describe the chosen output format.

positive_findings: The Drop audio here · Double-click for MIDI hint gave a clear first step.
Assign instrument is explicit and closes the chooser into an editable clip.
Duplicate tool creates the next adjacent copy in one click.
Fit keeps the growing arrangement visible.
Save and export dialogs provide names by default, so the mouse-only constraint did not block file creation.
Arranger ruler includes seconds, enabling a 30-second target without changing tempo.
environment_limitations: No audible monitoring; content existence and nonzero render were verified, musical sound quality was not.
Only the lab VST3 fixture was supplied; Preview Failed appears because it has no custom GUI. This is not treated as a third-party plugin defect.
Default stock audio supplied material; importing external audio was not exercised.
